display_long_description:
Your living room just froze over.

Look down. The floor of your real room turns into a frozen lake — a sheet of ice stretching across your actual living space through mixed reality. Grab a rock, smash a hole through the ice, drop your line, and pull up your catch, all without leaving your couch.
[media]
How it works:

Your floor becomes an icy lake surface. Break through the ice to open a single fishing hole, drop your line into the cold water below, and watch fish swim beneath your feet before they strike. Every bite, tug, and reel is felt as fish fight your line.

Right beside you, a warm campfire crackles. Roast the fish you catch over the open flame, eat, and restore your energy to keep fishing longer.

Feeling competitive? To your left, a timed challenge waits. Race the clock and beat your personal fishing record — how many fish can you land before time runs out?

Features:

Turn your real floor into a frozen ice-fishing lake with mixed reality
Smash the ice open and drop your line through the hole
Watch fish swim beneath the ice before they bite
Feel every strike, tug, and reel as fish fight back
Catch different fish species and build your collection
Roast your catch over a cozy campfire to restore energy
Timed record-breaking challenge mode
Cozy, calming, and unlike anything else on Quest

Grab your rod. The ice is waiting.
